How to read this

Each standing is computed from the knowledge store and the contract only, with the rules show uses. The scope is the provider https://api.hearth.test, the environment production and the contract digest sha256:ed12df455ad40c4c0d8430967cb3cc0274068ee62ddee6f90bf50e85f828e195: exactly the identity show binds. Responses retained under another environment, provider or contract version are counted beside a standing and never change it. A counted response is a client observation in this scope that is complete, has a status, is within the 180-day staleness horizon and whose evidence file still matches its recorded digest; evidence is hashed, never read for content. "using parameters the contract does not declare" names the query parameter names recorded in the request shape of the newest counted request that the contract does not declare for that operation; an operation with a declared parameter that cannot be resolved to a name and location is not checked. "learned" is the legacy learn verification of the contract shape, shown beside and never merged. Notes are active authored notes with their recorded author, date and evidence run ids; they are claims, not verification. Key sources are recorded links from a path or query key to the earlier response field it came from. No request or response values appear on this page; a stored or declared value the secret scan flags reads withheld.
